s.en: manipulate the utilization clamping attributes of the system or a process

syn: uclampset [options] [-m minimum] [-M maximum] -p PID ⏎ uclampset [options] [-m minimum] [-M maximum] command [argument...]

o.en: Set or retrieve the utilization clamping attributes of all the tasks (threads) for a given PID.
Operate on an existing PID and do not launch a new task.
Set or retrieve the system-wide utilization clamping attributes.
